about_the_game:
IT'S NOT A REMASTER. IT'S A RECONSTRUCTION.

Step back into the shoes of a tormented detective in Gloomy Clues: The Broken Mirror, a complete, from-the-ground-up remake of the original mystery. We've thrown out the old blueprints and rebuilt the entire experience in a modern engine to deliver the definitive version of the story. This is not just a coat of paint; it's a new foundation, addressing the feedback and limitations of the original to create the game it was always meant to be. Immerse yourself in a dark, rain-soaked city where every shadow hides a secret and every character has something to lose. A renowned musician has been found dead under murky circumstances. As you delve deeper, you'll uncover a web of lies and despair that threatens to consume you, forcing you to confront not only the city's demons, but your own.

A TRUE REMAKE FROM THE GROUND UP

Experience the story with the quality and polish it always deserved. We've re-engineered every aspect of the game to create a modern and deeply immersive investigative experience.

  • Rebuilt in a New Engine: Enjoy a stable, polished, and smooth gameplay experience impossible in the original, with faster loading times and modern performance.

  • Completely Revamped Art Direction: We've created a brand-new visual identity to fully immerse you in the game's moody, noir atmosphere.

  • Modernized User Interface: Investigate with ease. A sleek, redesigned UI allows you to navigate your clues, notes, and deductions more intuitively than ever before.

  • Enhanced Sound and Music: Let the unforgettable, melancholic jazz soundtrack envelop you, now with a fully remastered, high-quality score.

BECOME THE DETECTIVE

  • Search for Clues: Scour detailed, atmospheric locations for hidden objects and crucial evidence. Every item tells a part of the story.

  • Interrogate Witnesses: Engage in tense conversations where your choices matter. Use empathy, aggression, or direct logic to uncover the truth, but be mindful of the consequences.

  • Solve the Case: Piece together the evidence, challenge your own conclusions, and make the final deduction. Will you bring justice, or will the case remain unsolved?

  • Face Your Inner Demons: The city's darkness is not the only thing you'll be fighting. The detective's past is always lurking, and your psychological state will be tested.

WILL YOU UNCOVER THE TRUTH, OR WILL THE DARKNESS CONSUME YOU?

The city has secrets, but the greatest mystery might be the one lurking in your own mind.

Wishlist Gloomy Clues: The Broken Mirror and play the free demo to begin your investigation today!

content_descriptors.notes:
"Gloomy Clues" is a narrative mystery and murder adventure, so some of its content may not be appropriate for all audiences.

Violence: While the game's aesthetic is anime-style, crime scenes are depicted with the presence of blood. Players will encounter bodies as part of the investigations, but there is no explicit gore or gratuitous graphic violence. The gravity of the acts is conveyed through the atmosphere, dialogues, and clues that are discovered.

Sensitive themes: The plot explores the psyche of a detective tormented by his past and the struggle against his own darkness. Themes such as guilt, psychological trauma, and loss are addressed. While there are no explicit depictions of abuse, past events are implied that could be disturbing to some players.

Other aspects: The game does not contain nudity, explicit sexual content, or obscene language. The consumption of drugs or alcohol is not encouraged.

Age recommendation: Taking the above into account, we recommend "Gloomy Clues" for players over 16 years old.
